parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use the correct product rule; an incorrect chain rule is condoned, but using a numerical value of $a$ is not equivalent work. parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Use integration by parts to obtain an expression of the form $pxe^{-ax}+q\int e^{-ax}dx$; condone a sign error in the parts formula or omission of $dx$, but not a numerical value for $a$. [*M1] Obtain $-\frac1a xe^{-ax}+\frac1a\int e^{-ax}dx$. [A1] Complete the integration to $-\frac1a xe^{-ax}-\frac1{a^2}e^{-ax}$. [A1] Use limits $0$ and $2/a$ correctly in an expression of the form $rxe^{-ax}+se^{-ax}$. [DM1] Obtain $\frac1{a^2}(1-3e^{-2})$, or the printed equivalent $\frac{e^2-3}{a^2e^2}$; ISW. [A1] Total: 5.
